died.name: Hugh Latimer
died.cause: to Nicholas Ridley while they were burning at the stake for heresy
died.last_words: Be of good comfort, Master Ridley, and play the man; we shall this day light such a candle by God's grace in England as (I trust) shall never be put out.

died.name: Nicholas Ridley
died.cause: While burning at the stake for heresy, only his lower limbs burned away
died.last_words: Let the flames come near me. I cannot burn! I cannot burn!

died.name: François de Malherbe
died.cause: listening on his deathbed to his confessor describing the glories of heaven
died.last_words: Hold your tongue; your wretched style only makes me out of conceit with them.

died.name: Marie Antoinette
died.cause: apologizing to her executioner for stepping on his foot prior to her execution by guillotine
died.last_words: Pardon me, sir. I did not do it on purpose.

died.name: Eva Marie Veigel
died.desc: Viennese dancer and wife of David Garrick
died.cause: telling a servant to put down a cup of tea prior to dying at age 98
died.last_words: Put it down, hussy! Do you think I cannot help myself?

died.name: Alfred Jodl
died.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
died.last_words: My greetings to you, my Germany.

died.name: Alfred Rosenberg
died.desc: Baltic German Nazi theorist and ideologue
died.cause: when asked if he had anything to say prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)

died.name: Arthur Seyss-Inquart
died.desc: Austrian Nazi politician, Reichskommissar of the occupied Netherlands
died.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
died.last_words: I hope that this execution is the last act of the tragedy of the Second World War and that the lesson taken from this world war will be that peace and understanding should exist between peoples. I believe in Germany.

died.name: Ernst Kaltenbrunner
died.desc: Austrian SS official, major perpetrator of The Holocaust
died.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
died.last_words: I have loved my German people and my fatherland with a warm heart. I have done my duty by the laws of my people and I am sorry my people were led this time by men who were not soldiers and that crimes were committed of which I had no knowledge. Germany, good luck.

died.name: Fritz Sauckel
died.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
died.last_words: I am dying innocent. The sentence is wrong. God protect Germany and make Germany great again. Long live Germany! God protect my family.

died.name: Hans Frank
died.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
died.last_words: I am thankful for the kind of treatment during my captivity and I ask God to accept me with mercy.

died.name: Joachim von Ribbentrop
died.desc: German politician, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Nazi Germany
died.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
died.last_words: God protect Germany. May I say something else? My last wish is that Germany realize its entity and that an understanding be reached between the East and the West. I wish peace to the world.

died.name: Julius Streicher
died.desc: Nazi politician, founder and publisher of Der Stürmer
died.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
died.last_words: Heil Hitler, this is my Purim Fest in 1946! I am going to God. The Bolsheviks will hang you one day!

died.name: Neville Heath
died.cause: when he was offered a drink prior to his execution by hanging
died.last_words: You might make that a double.

died.name: Wilhelm Frick
died.desc: German politician of the Nazi Party
died.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)

died.name: Wilhelm Keitel
died.cause: during his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)

died.name: George Hennard
died.cause: to first responders before committing suicide
died.last_words: No, I'm going to kill more people.

died.name: Sharon Lopatka
died.cause: The 35-year-old exchanged emails with her killer, Robert Glass, in which she said she wanted to be "tortured to death"-an apparent case of consensual homicide.

born.name: Albrecht von Haller
born.last_words: My friend, the artery ceases to beat.

born.name: Noah Webster
born.last_words: I have struggled with many difficulties. Some I have been able to overcome and by some I have been overcome. I have made many mistakes but I love my country and have labored for the youth of my country, and I trust no precept of mine has taught any dear youth to sin.

born.name: Oscar Wilde
born.last_words: My wallpaper and I are fighting a duel to the death. One or the other of us has to go.

born.name: Kaʻiulani
born.desc: last heir apparent to the throne of the Hawaiian Kingdom
born.cause: She may have said "Mama", "Papa" or "Koa" (a nickname for her cousin)

born.name: Franz Reichelt
born.desc: Austro-Hungarian born French tailor and inventor
born.cause: prior to leaping from Eiffel Tower in fatal test of "parachute suit" The 33-year-old tailor and inventor leaped from the Eiffel Tower wearing a parachute made from cloth, his own invention, and fell 57 m to his death. He was asked by friends and authorities to use a dummy for the feat, but declined, saying "I intend to prove the worth of my invention". His impact crater was 15 cm deep.

born.name: Eugene O'Neill
born.last_words: I knew it! I knew it! Born in a hotel room and, goddamn it, dying in a hotel room.

born.name: Michael Collins
born.cause: mortally wounded in anti-Treaty IRA ambush
born.last_words: Forgive them. Bury me in Glasnevin with the boys.

born.name: Donald E. Montgomery
born.last_words: I have laid my papers on a bed for my daughters. I have left the door open for the police to enter. I am going to shoot myself.

born.name: Karen Wetterhahn
born.cause: The 48-year-old chemistry professor at Dartmouth College died ten months after a few drops of dimethylmercury (an organomercury compound and one of the strongest-known neurotoxins) landed on her protective gloves. Although she had been following the required procedures, it permeated the gloves and her skin within seconds.
